title: 6 batch drinks for a boat with no glass
caption:
Save this before your boat day 🧊🍹 Which one is your group making?

#byob #houstonbachelorette #htx #clearlake

slides.headline: 6 batch drinks for a boat with no glass
slides.body: Cans, jugs and pouches only. Save this for the group chat.

slides.headline: Frozen pouch margaritas.
slides.body: Freeze them the night before. They're slush by the time you board.

slides.headline: Ranch Water, can edition.
slides.body: Canned Topo Chico, tequila in a plastic flask, a bag of lime wedges.

slides.headline: The Paloma jug.
slides.body: Grapefruit soda cans and tequila in a gallon jug. Shake before pouring.

slides.headline: Spiked Arnold Palmer.
slides.body: Half tea, half lemonade, all in one jug. The easiest thing on this list.

slides.headline: Rose frozen grapes.
slides.body: Soak them overnight, freeze them. They're the ice and the snack.

slides.headline: Jello shots in the bride's colors.
slides.body: Or your team's colors. Cups with lids travel best.

slides.headline: No glass on the boat.
slides.body: Pour everything into plastic at home. Your future self says thanks.

slides.headline: Freeze your water bottles.
slides.body: They're ice packs on the way out and cold water on the way back.

slides.headline: Which one is your crew making?
slides.body: Save this, send it to whoever's on cooler duty. @houstonpedalbarge
